facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; foreign clients' payments aren't domestic transactions under kwacha rules.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: hold accounts in local or foreign currency; cash withdrawals capped.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register a business name with PACRA as a sole proprietor.
facts.L2_tax_id: TPIN from the Zambia Revenue Authority, using your NRC.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Zambian-source income taxed; turnover tax of 5% up to K5 million.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 16% VAT above K800,000 a year; services performed in Zambia aren't zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: Register with the Data Protection Commissioner; not registering is an offence.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can cancel online purchases within seven days.
facts.L7_incentives: No freelancer incentive; 5% turnover tax up to K5 million.

watch_out.text: Work done in Zambia for foreign clients still carries 16% VAT once registered.
Older guides say K800,000 and 4%; turnover tax is now 5% up to K5m.
